mcmti.midnightconfig.apiBaseUrl.tooltip: API base URL ending with /v1 (no trailing slash required). MiMo: https://api.xiaomimimo.com/v1 · DashScope: https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 · local vLLM: http://host:port/v1
mcmti.midnightconfig.apiKey.tooltip: API key. Required for cloud providers; optional for local OpenAI-compatible servers.
mcmti.midnightconfig.asrProvider.tooltip: Online speech recognition provider. Select 'Plugin' to dispatch to a third-party ASR plugin mod (e.g. mcmti-dashscope-plugin).
mcmti.midnightconfig.language.tooltip: Language hint. MiMo: auto/zh/en. OpenAI-compatible: auto omits language; otherwise zh/en/… DashScope plugin: auto omits language_hints; otherwise zh/en/ja/ko/…
mcmti.midnightconfig.model.tooltip: ASR model id. MiMo: mimo-v2.5-asr · DashScope (OpenAI-compat): qwen3-asr-flash · DashScope plugin: paraformer-realtime-v2 · local: model path/name
mcmti.midnightconfig.prefix.tooltip: Prefix added to the recognized text.
mcmti.midnightconfig.pluginProviderId.to: Provider id of the ASR plugin to use when ASR Provider is 'Plugin'. Example: dashscope (from mcmti-dashscope-plugin).
mcmti.midnightconfig.requestTimeoutMs.to: HTTP timeout for online speech recognition.
mcmti.midnightconfig.httpProxy.tooltip: Optional HTTP proxy for ASR requests. Leave empty for direct connection. http:// is optional. Examples: 127.0.0.1:7890 · user:pass@host:port
mcmti.midnightconfig.transcriptionPrompt: OpenAI /audio/transcriptions prompt field only — vocabulary, domain topic, or previous-segment context. NOT a chat system prompt: do not put role/instructions like summarize or output format. Leave empty to omit.
mcmti.midnightconfig.title: Microphone Text Input Config
message.mcmti.speechRecognizerNotReady: §cSpeech Recognizer Not Ready (check API URL / key)
